title: macroptilium campestre
intro: Macroptilium campestre, commonly known as stickleaf or beggar's lice, is a species of flowering plant in the pea family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing various health benefits such as treating fever, cough, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Macroptilium campestre include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which contribute to its use in treating various health issues. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
